sentences.text: This first application under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail relating to Crime No. 388/2024 registered at Police Station- Saman, District- Rewa for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 468, 471, 409 and 120-B of the IPC.

The applicant is in jail since 30.01.2025.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that on the earlier occasion he moved an anticipatory bail application which was rejected directing the applicant to file regular bail application before the Court below and if it is done, the same shall be considered by the Court on the same day.
The Court considered the bail application and rejected the same and hence this regular bail application before this Court.

3. sentences.text: In the meantime, the vehicle met with an accident and therefore, a complaint was made that the present applicant had committed fraud and cheated the complainant.
4. Shri Agnihotri, learned counsel for the State opposed the submissions of learned counsel for the applicant and relied upon the order passed by the Court below.
5. Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and perusal of case-diary,

, I am of the opinion that when first installment was paid to the Insurance Company through online payment then second installment was not required to be paid by cash and if it is denied, it is a factual aspect of the matter and the same shall be decided during the course of trial.
At this stage, I am inclined to consider and allow this bail application.
Therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this bail application is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance on the dates given by it.
On being released on bail, the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 480(3) of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
